review: Very disappointed with the food and service at Annapoorna Hotel, Ulundurpet Highway. I ordered Veg Noodles and Mushroom Fried Rice, but they served oily Paneer Veg Noodles and normal Veg Fried Rice instead. Also, the rice was not properly cooked. The taste was not worth the money at all. There was no menu card available, so customers could not check the food prices before ordering. For just these two items, the bill was ₹461, which felt too expensive for the quality and quantity provided. The hotel really needs improvement in food quality, order accuracy, pricing transparency, and customer service. Totally Review 0.8/10
